titulo: What Happens to the Ladybugs Hiding in Your House This Winter?
titulos_alternativos: Why Ladybugs Move Into Your House Every Fall
The Ladybugs in Your Walls Aren't Ladybugs
descripcion:
It is a sunny afternoon in October and the whole side of your house is crawling with little orange beetles. A week later they are gone, except for the one walking across your ceiling. So where did they go, what are they doing inside your walls all winter, and why did they pick your house?

Meet the Asian lady beetle: why your sunny wall looks like a cliff to it, how it sleeps through winter in your attic, why a warm day wakes it up too early, the smelly yellow liquid it bleeds from its knees, and the easy way to get them out without stains.
